task: Scope a multi-phase initiative. Problem: our engineering skill collection is hard to adopt and mostly Python-specific, costing repeated setup and weak results outside Python. In scope: a simple router-only installer, TypeScript and major-language support for generally applicable skills, and installed user-journey verification. Out of scope: a cryptographic supply-chain platform, automatic workflow DAGs, and framework support beyond one later pilot. Non-goals: perfect security against a compromised source repository and simultaneous support for every language. Success: a fresh project installs exactly three routers with one documented command; 22 language-level skills have honest TypeScript outcomes; one installed route loads only the selected closure and reaches its final artifact. The current priorities are installation, multi-language support, then user journey; review complaints that do not materially affect them stay deferred.

In scope: one canonical serializer, all three callers, and regression fixtures. Out of scope: redesigning the admin UI and changing storage. Non-goal: a general event platform. Success: the same 50-record fixture is byte-identical across all three paths; malformed records fail with the same typed error; existing API latency p95 stays below 250ms. These answers are confirmed.
